---
title: "Tasmania"
subtitle: "General Government Sector fiscal positions"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
tar_source("R")

JURIS <- "TAS"

facts <- tryCatch(
  tar_read(facts_latest) |> filter(jurisdiction == JURIS),
  error = function(e) tibble::tibble()
)

per_capita <- tryCatch(
  tar_read(facts_per_capita) |> filter(jurisdiction == JURIS),
  error = function(e) tibble::tibble()
)

per_gsp <- tryCatch(
  tar_read(facts_per_gsp) |> filter(jurisdiction == JURIS),
  error = function(e) tibble::tibble()
)

# Friendly status label so legends say "Actual" / "Forecast" not TRUE/FALSE.
status_lbl <- function(b) {
  ## Always return character (even on 0-length input) so bind_rows
  ## across possibly-empty per-capita / per-GSP panels doesn't blow
  ## up with type mismatch.
  out <- ifelse(b, "Forecast", "Actual")
  as.character(out)
}

# Small helper: build a single-variable timeline plot.
sbm_state_plot <- function(d, title) {
  if (nrow(d) == 0L) {
    return(htmltools::p(htmltools::em(paste0(title, ": no data extracted yet."))))
  }
  d <- d |>
    arrange(fiscal_year) |>
    mutate(status = status_lbl(is_forward_estimate))
  plot_ly(d,
          x = ~fiscal_year, y = ~value_aud_mil,
          color = ~status,
          colors = c(Actual = "#1f3a93", Forecast = "#a6611a"),
          type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
          line = list(width = 2.5),
          hovertemplate = "<b>%{x}</b><br>%{y:,.0f} AUD mil<extra></extra>") |>
    plotly::layout(
      title  = title,
      font   = list(family = "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif", size = 12L),
      legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.18, title = list(text = "")),
      margin = list(l = 60L, r = 20L, t = 50L, b = 70L),
      xaxis  = list(title = "", tickangle = -45),
      yaxis  = list(title = "AUD millions", tickformat = ",")
    )
}
```

## Headline aggregates

```{r rev}
if (nrow(facts) > 0L)
```

## Drill-down

```{r drill}
if (nrow(facts) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("No data.")
} else {
  vars <- facts |>
    distinct(canonical_label) |>
    arrange(canonical_label) |>
    pull(canonical_label)

  default_var <- if ("Net debt" %in% vars) "Net debt" else vars[[1L]]

  ## Build one trace per (variable x status), default-hide all except
  ## the chosen default variable. Plotly's updatemenus dropdown then
  ## flips visibility per user selection. This is the only way to get
  ## a "show one variable at a time" UI in crosstalk-free plotly ---
  ## crosstalk's filter_select treats empty selection as "show all"
  ## which produces the spaghetti view.
  p <- plot_ly()
  trace_var    <- character(0)
  trace_status <- character(0)
  for (v in vars) {
    d <- facts |>
      filter(canonical_label == v) |>
      mutate(status = status_lbl(is_forward_estimate)) |>
      arrange(fiscal_year)
    for (s in c("Actual", "Forecast")) {
      ds <- d |> filter(status == s)
      if (nrow(ds) == 0L) next
      col <- if (s == "Actual") "#1f3a93" else "#a6611a"
      p <- p |> add_trace(
        data = ds,
        x = ~fiscal_year, y = ~value_aud_mil,
        type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
        name = s, legendgroup = s,
        showlegend = (v == default_var),
        line   = list(color = col, width = 2.5),
        marker = list(color = col),
        visible = (v == default_var),
        hovertemplate = "<b>%{x}</b><br>%{y:,.0f} AUD mil<extra></extra>"
      )
      trace_var    <- c(trace_var, v)
      trace_status <- c(trace_status, s)
    }
  }

  buttons <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
    visible <- trace_var == v
    list(
      method = "update",
      label  = v,
      args   = list(
        list(visible    = visible,
             showlegend = visible),
        list(title = paste(JURIS, "---", v))
      )
    )
  })

  p |> plotly::layout(
    title = paste(JURIS, "---", default_var),
    font  = list(family = "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif", size = 12L),
    updatemenus = list(list(
      active    = which(vars == default_var) - 1L,
      buttons   = buttons,
      type      = "dropdown",
      x         = 0,    y         = 1.18,
      xanchor   = "left", yanchor = "top",
      bgcolor   = "#f8f9fa",
      bordercolor = "#dee2e6"
    )),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.18, title = list(text = "")),
    margin = list(l = 60L, r = 20L, t = 90L, b = 70L),
    xaxis  = list(title = "", tickangle = -45),
    yaxis  = list(title = "AUD millions", tickformat = ",")
  )
}
```

## All variables

```{r table}
if (nrow(facts) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("No data.")
} else {
  facts |>
    arrange(category, canonical_label, fiscal_year) |>
    transmute(
      Category = category,
      Variable = canonical_label,
      `FY`     = fiscal_year,
      `Value (AUD mil)` = round(value_aud_mil),
      Status   = status_lbl(is_forward_estimate),
      Source   = document_id
    ) |>
    reactable(
      defaultPageSize = 15,
      searchable      = TRUE,
      filterable      = TRUE,
      striped         = TRUE,
      columns = list(
        `Value (AUD mil)` = colDef(format = colFormat(separators = TRUE))
      )
    )
}
```
